snippet.title: Atomic Heart - Blood on Crystal DLC#4 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Atomic Heart now: https://www.focus-entmt.com/games/atomic-heart?utm_campaign=AH_LaunchDLC4&utm_medium=post&utm_source=YouTube

Experience the thrilling, high-stake conclusion of Atomic Heart with the Blood on Crystal DLC#4! 💥

Venture deeper in Facility 3826 to battle CHAR-les and make a last desperate bid to save humanity from total annihilation. Adapt your fighting style on the fly and make the most of your arsenal.
